annotations.title: Beach: dog rules today, parking permit, lifeguards

description: One named beach, or every verified beach in a town, village or hamlet ('Amagansett, NY' and 'Sag Harbour' resolve, and `readAs` reports which place was answered for). 49 beaches on both forks, each with: whether dogs are allowed today (the rule is per month and splits morning from daytime; most South Fork ocean beaches are off-leash at dawn and closed to dogs in daylight from May to September), the parking permit the lot needs, whether it is reachable without a car, lifeguard hours, rip-current notes, the governing town, village or state source, and the date it was last read. Permit information here is the line for each named beach only; it does not include non-resident day passes or the permit map by jurisdiction. Returns up to 5. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.
